reports.name: Inwarded Raw Material after Inspection (Old. In later added additional column and rearranged columns)

 from rm_inwarddetails left join rm_inwardmaster on RI_ID = RD_RIID
 left join materialmaster on RD_RMID = MM_Id
 left join supplier on RI_SUPPLIERID = ss_Id
 left join materialtypemaster on MM_mtId=mt_id

reports.name: Current Raw Material Stock in Stores(Batchwise)
reports.queryTemplate:
select * from (SELECT RD_BATCHNO as 'Batch No',
		MM_RawMtPartNo as 'Raw Material',
        MT_Name as 'Material Type',
		round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END)
			- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END), 2 ) AS 'Qty(Kg)'
	FROM rm_inwarddetails , rm_inwardmaster, materialmaster, materialtypemaster
    where rd_riid=ri_id and RD_RMID = MM_Id and MM_mtId = MT_Id
    group by RD_BATCHNO, RD_RMID order by `Qty(Kg)`) t where `Qty(Kg)` != 0;

reports.name: Monthly Material Movement

CASE when RI_MOVEMENT = 'I' then 'Inward' else 'Outward' end as Movement, ML_DESCRIPTION as 'Purpose',

left join components on RD_COMPID = CO_ID
left join materialmaster on RD_RMID = MM_Id
, rm_movements , users

 month(RI_DATE) ={month} and year(RI_DATE) = {year}  and rd_acceptedqty>0

reports.name: Production between dates (date production entry is made and not ref to schedule
reports.queryTemplate:
select DATE_FORMAT(pd_date, '%d-%m-%Y') 'ProductionDate', CO_PARTNO 'Part No', PD_LotNo 'Lot No',MCM_Name Machine, OP_NAME'Operator', CT_TOOLNO Tool, MM_RawMtPartNo 'Raw Material', pd_batchno 'Batch No', pd_prodqty  'No Of Comp', PD_SFREJECT 'SF Rej(Nos)',PD_SWQTY 'SU Wastage(Nos)',PD_SCRAPQTY 'Scrap(Kg)',PD_QTYKG 'Part Wt(Kg)', round(pd_prodqty/conVal,4) 'Theo RM(Kg)', round(pd_prodqty*co_weight/1000,4) 'Theo Part Wt', 
round( (pd_prodqty/conVal -pd_prodqty*co_weight/1000),4) as 'Theo Scrap'
from production_details 
left join machinemaster on MCM_Id= PD_MCID
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join components_tool on ct_id =pd_toolid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join operators on PD_OPID = OP_ID 
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id 
where Date(pd_date) between {fromDate} and {toDate} 
  and pd_ecsid = 8
order by pd_date desc

reports.name: Distinct Tools with PartNos
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    ct_toolno AS Tool,
    max(TL_spm) AS SPM,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CT_PITCH ORDER BY CT_PITCH SEPARATOR ' ,') AS 'Pitch',
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CT_NO_OF_CAVITY ORDER BY CT_NO_OF_CAVITY SEPARATOR '  ,') AS 'Cavity', 
    COUNT(*) AS 'Component Count',
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(MM_RawMtPartNo), '')) AS 'Raw Material Count',
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component1,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component2,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component3,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component4,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial1,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial2,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial3,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN MM_RawMtPartNo END), '') AS RawMaterial4
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ct_toolno,
        CO_PARTNO,
        CT_PITCH,
        CT_NO_OF_CAVITY,
        MM_RawMtPartNo,
a.TL_spm ,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct_toolno ORDER BY CO_PARTNO) AS rn
    FROM components_tool 
    LEFT JOIN components ON CT_COMPID = CO_ID
    LEFT JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = mm_id
    LEFT JOIN (select distinct TRIM(TL_tool_number) AS TL_tool_number,MAX(TL_spm) AS TL_spm from tool_life GROUP BY TRIM(TL_tool_number)) a on a.TL_tool_number = ct_toolno 
    WHERE ct_activeyn = 'Y'
) t
GROUP BY ct_toolno
ORDER BY ct_toolno;

reports.name: Dispatch between dates (with ref to schedule and not atual dispatch date)
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  CU_Name AS Customer,
  CO_partNo AS 'Part No',
  CO_partName AS 'Part Name',
  DISPATCH_PLANT_ID AS 'Dispatch Unit',
  DATE_FORMAT(CS_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Requested Date',
  CS_QTY AS 'Requested Qty(Nos)',
  case when SD_STATUS=7 then
COALESCE(SD_LOTSIZE,0) 
else 0 end
AS 'Dispatched Qty(Nos)',
  SD_INVOICE AS 'Invoice Number',
  DATE_FORMAT(SD_DISPATCHDATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Invoice Date',
  COALESCE(DS_NAME,'Not Dispatched') as 'Status'
FROM scheduled_customer
LEFT join (select sd_csid,SD_INVOICE,SD_DISPATCHDATE,SD_Status, sum(coalesce(sd_lotsize,0)) sd_lotsize  from scheduled_customerdispatch group by sd_csid,SD_INVOICE,SD_DISPATCHDATE,SD_Status) disp
		on disp.sd_csid = cs_id 
INNER JOIN customer ON CU_Id = CS_CUSTID
INNER JOIN schedule_details ON SC_Id = CS_SCID
INNER JOIN components ON CO_Id = SC_COMPID
LEFT JOIN dispatch_status ON DS_Id = SD_Status
WHERE CS_SCHEDULESTATE in ( 1,2,3)
 AND CS_DATE BETWEEN {fromDate}
AND {toDate};

reports.name: QA  Pending Components
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
    co_partno 'Part No',
    SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    SUM(ProdQA_pending) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    SUM(qa_disp_pending) AS 'QA Disposition',
    SUM(rw_pending) AS 'Rework Pending'
FROM (
    -- qaPending from comp_inwardmaster + qa_details
    SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending,
           0 as ProdQA_pending,
           0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_inwardmaster
    INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
    INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
    WHERE CM_PLANT = {plantid}
      AND QD_STATUS = 'P'
      AND QD_CRID = 0
    GROUP BY CD_COMPID


union all
-- qa pending from production_details & qa_details
    select PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id,0 as QASup_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending,0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
	from scheduled_production
	inner join production_details on ps_id = pd_psid
	inner join qa_details on pd_id = qd_pdid
	WHERE pd_plantid =  {plantid}
      AND QD_STATUS = 'P'
      AND QD_CRID = 0
      group by PS_PARENTCOMPID

 
    UNION ALL

    -- qaDispositionPending
    SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id,
           0 AS qa_pending,0 as ProdQA_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_rejectdetails
    WHERE CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
      AND CR_STATUS = 'P'
    GROUP BY CR_COMPID
    
union all

 SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id,
           0 AS qa_pending,0 as ProdQA_pending,
           0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_rejectdetails
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT RD_CRID AS crId, SUM(RD_QTY) AS rdQty
        FROM comp_rejinvdetails
        INNER JOIN comp_rejinvmaster ON RD_RJID = RJ_ID
        INNER JOIN comp_rejectdetails ON CR_ID = RD_CRID
        WHERE RJ_MOVEMENT = 'O'
          AND CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
          AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
        GROUP BY RD_CRID
    ) t ON t.crId = CR_ID
    WHERE CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
      AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
    GROUP BY CR_COMPID    
) combined left join components on co_id = comp_id
GROUP BY comp_id
order by co_partno

reports.name: Supplier Component Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
select co_partno 'Part No', 
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 2 THEN compbalance END) AS '1st Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 3 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Electroplating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 4 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Soapwash',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 5 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Tapping',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 6 THEN compbalance END) AS 'FG',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 7 THEN compbalance END) AS '2nd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 8 THEN compbalance END) AS '3rd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 9 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Etching',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 10 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Deburring',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 12 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Laser Welding',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 13 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 14 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Arcor Coating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 15 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Riveting',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 16 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Brazing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 17 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Heat Sealing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 18 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Dimpling'
from
 (
select co_id,CO_PARTNO,cd_opstage, COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN cm_movement = 'O' THEN cd_qty
                WHEN cm_movement = 'I' THEN -cd_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0
    ) 
    - COALESCE(sum(sd_qty), 0) AS compbalance
    from  comp_inwardmaster, comp_inwarddetails
    left join comp_opstages on cd_opstage=os_id 
	left join components on CD_COMPID= co_id and CO_ACTIVEYN='Y'
    left join comp_scrapdetails   on  sd_source='S' and sd_src=3 and sd_refno=CD_CMID and sd_compid = cd_compid and SD_OPSTAGE= cd_opstage
    where cm_id = cd_cmid and co_id is not null and CD_SOURCE='C'

    group by cd_compid,cd_opstage) t
    where compbalance >0
    group by co_partno
    order by CO_PARTNO;

reports.name: Consolidated
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    AP.co_partno AS 'Part No',AP.CO_PARTNAME,AP.CO_WEIGHT,AP.MT_Name,
    
    -- Stock Values (Q1)
    COALESCE(S.stk_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_FG, 0) AS 'FG (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (Stock)',

    -- Balance Values (Q3)
    COALESCE(B.bal_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_FG, 0) AS 'FG (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (WIP Bal)',

    -- QA and Rework (Q2)
    COALESCE(Q.qa_supplier, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_production, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_disposition, 0) AS 'QA Disposition',
    COALESCE(Q.rework_pending, 0) AS 'Rework Pending'

-- FIX 1: Drive the query off a purely distinct list of Part Numbers
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME,CO_WEIGHT,MT_Name
    FROM components inner join materialtypemaster on MT_Id = CO_MATERIALTYPEID
    WHERE co_partno IS NOT NULL and CO_ACTIVEYN ='Y' and co_id=CO_PARENTID
) AP

-- Stock Values logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno AS PartNo, CO_PARTNAME as CO_PARTNAME,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 2  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_1st_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 3  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Electroplating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 4  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Soapwash,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 5  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 6  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_FG,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 7  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_2nd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 8  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_3rd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 9  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Laser_Welding,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Arcor_Coating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Dimpling
    FROM (
        SELECT co_partno,CO_PARTNAME, os_id, cs_qty 
        FROM comp_stock 
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CS_STAGEID = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CS_COMPID = co_id
        WHERE cs_plantid = {plantid}
    ) t1
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME = S.CO_PARTNAME

-- QA & Rework logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        co_partno AS PartNo,CO_PARTNAME,
        SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(ProdQA_pending)    AS qa_production,
        SUM(qa_disp_pending)   AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(rw_pending)        AS rework_pending
    FROM (
        SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
        WHERE CM_PLANT = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY CD_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id, 0 as QASup_pending, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM scheduled_production
        INNER JOIN production_details ON ps_id = pd_psid
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON pd_id = qd_pdid
        WHERE pd_plantid = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY PS_PARENTCOMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        WHERE CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'P'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t2.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending

        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Dimpling,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 19 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_CPInspection
    FROM (
        SELECT co_partno,CO_PARTNAME, os_id, cs_qty 
        FROM comp_stock 
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CS_STAGEID = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CS_COMPID = co_id
        WHERE cs_plantid = {plantid}
    ) t1
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME = S.CO_PARTNAME

-- QA & Rework logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        co_partno AS PartNo,CO_PARTNAME,
        SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(ProdQA_pending)    AS qa_production,
        SUM(qa_disp_pending)   AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(rw_pending)        AS rework_pending
    FROM (
        SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
        WHERE CM_PLANT = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY CD_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id, 0 as QASup_pending, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM scheduled_production
        INNER JOIN production_details ON ps_id = pd_psid
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON pd_id = qd_pdid
        WHERE pd_plantid = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY PS_PARENTCOMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        WHERE CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'P'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t2.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT RD_CRID AS crId, SUM(RD_QTY) AS rdQty
            FROM comp_rejinvdetails
            INNER JOIN comp_rejinvmaster ON RD_RJID = RJ_ID
            INNER JOIN comp_rejectdetails ON CR_ID = RD_CRID
            WHERE RJ_MOVEMENT = 'O' AND CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
            GROUP BY RD_CRID
        ) t2 ON t2.crId = CR_ID
        WHERE CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID    
    ) combined 
    LEFT JOIN components ON co_id = comp_id
    -- FIX 2: Group strictly by Part Number, omitting comp_id 
    GROUP BY co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME
) Q ON AP.co_partno = Q.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME=Q.CO_PARTNAME

-- Balance Data logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno AS PartNo, CO_PARTNAME,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 2  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_1st_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 3  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Electroplating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 4  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Soapwash,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 5  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 6  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_FG,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 7  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_2nd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 8  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_3rd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 9  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 10 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 12 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Laser_Welding,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 13 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 14 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Arcor_Coating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 15 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 16 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 17 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 18 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Dimpling,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 19 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_CPInspection
    FROM (
        SELECT co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME, cd_opstage, 
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cm_movement = 'O' THEN cd_qty WHEN cm_movement = 'I' THEN -cd_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(sum(sd_qty), 0) AS compbalance
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON cm_id = cd_cmid
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON cd_opstage = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CD_COMPID = co_id AND CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y'
        LEFT JOIN comp_scrapdetails ON sd_source='S' AND sd_src=3 AND sd_refno=CD_CMID AND sd_compid = cd_compid AND SD_OPSTAGE = cd_opstage
        WHERE cm_id = cd_cmid and co_id is not null and CD_SOURCE='C'
        GROUP BY cd_compid, cd_opstage, co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME
    ) t3
    WHERE compbalance > 0
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) B ON AP.co_partno = B.PartNo and Ap.CO_PARTNAME = B.CO_PARTNAME

-- Exclude blank rows 
WHERE S.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR Q.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR B.PartNo IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY AP.co_partno;

    COALESCE(B.bal_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (With Supplier)',

    COALESCE(B.bal_FG, 0) AS 'FG (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (With Supplier)',

    INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MT_Id = CO_MATERIALTYPEID
    WHERE co_partno IS NOT NULL AND CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y' AND co_id = CO_PARENTID
) AP

-- Stock Values

        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Electroplating,

        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 8 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_3rd_Forming,

        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Riveting,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Brazing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Dimpling
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (1, 2)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.co_partno

-- QA & Rework
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 51 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 52 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_production,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 53 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 54 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS rework_pending
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (1, 2)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) Q ON AP.co_partno = Q.co_partno

-- Balance Data
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 2 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_1st_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Electroplating,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 4 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Soapwash,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 5 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Tapping,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 6 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_FG,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 7 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_2nd_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 8 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_3rd_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 9 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Etching,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Deburring,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Laser_Welding,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Arcor_Coating,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Riveting,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Brazing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Heat_Sealing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Dimpling
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (0)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) B ON AP.co_partno = B.co_partno

WHERE (S.co_partno IS NOT NULL 
   OR Q.co_partno IS NOT NULL 
   OR B.co_partno IS NOT NULL) 
AND AP.MT_Name = {material_name}
ORDER BY AP.co_partno;

reports.name: Component Stock Pivot
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
    mt.MT_Name AS `Material Type`,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                -- SFG stages (all production stages except FG=6)
                WHEN ch.CH_STAGEID IN (2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12,13,14,15,16,17,18,51,52,53,54)
                    THEN (ch.CH_QTY * COALESCE(c.CO_WEIGHT, 0)) / 1000
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),
        3
    ) AS `Sum of SFG IN KGS`,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                -- FG stage
                WHEN ch.CH_STAGEID = 6
                    THEN (ch.CH_QTY * COALESCE(c.CO_WEIGHT, 0)) / 1000
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),
        3
    ) AS `Sum of FG IN KGS`
FROM comp_stockhistory ch
INNER JOIN components c
    ON c.CO_ID = ch.CH_COMPID
INNER JOIN materialtypemaster mt
    ON mt.MT_ID = c.CO_MATERIALTYPEID
WHERE ch.CH_QTY > 0
  AND ch.CH_PLANTID IN (0,1,2)   -- include with-supplier + in-house like weekly consolidated view
  AND ch.CH_YEAR = {year}
  AND ch.CH_MONTH = {month}
  AND ch.CH_WEEK = {week}
  AND c.CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y'
GROUP BY mt.MT_Name
ORDER BY mt.MT_Name;

    AP.CO_PARTNAME,

    -- Stock Values (Subquery S)
    COALESCE(S.stk_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (Stock)',

    COALESCE(B.bal_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (With Supplier)',

    COALESCE(B.bal_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_FG, 0) AS 'FG (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (With Supplier)',

    COALESCE(B.bal_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (With Supplier)',

    -- QA and Rework (Subquery Q)
    COALESCE(Q.qa_supplier, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_production, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_disposition, 0) AS 'QA Disposition',

FROM (

    FROM components 
    INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MT_Id = CO_MATERIALTYPEID
    WHERE co_partno IS NOT NULL AND CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y' AND co_id = CO_PARENTID
) AP

-- Stock Values
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 2 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_1st_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Electroplating,

        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Brazing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stk_Dimpling
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (1, 2)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.co_partno

-- QA & Rework
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 51 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 52 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_production,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 53 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 54 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS rework_pending
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (1, 2)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) Q ON AP.co_partno = Q.co_partno

-- Balance Data
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 2 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_1st_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Electroplating,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 4 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Soapwash,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 5 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Tapping,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 6 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_FG,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 7 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_2nd_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 8 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_3rd_Forming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 9 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Etching,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Deburring,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Laser_Welding,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Arcor_Coating,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Riveting,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Brazing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Heat_Sealing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN ch_qty ELSE 0 END) AS bal_Dimpling
    FROM comp_stockhistory
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CH_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CH_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE ch_qty > 0 AND ch_plantid IN (0)
    AND CH_YEAR = {year} AND CH_MONTH = {month}  AND CH_WEEK = {week}
    GROUP BY co_partno
) B ON AP.co_partno = B.co_partno

WHERE S.co_partno IS NOT NULL 
   OR Q.co_partno IS NOT NULL 
   OR B.co_partno IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY AP.co_partno;

reports.name: Tool History
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(x.event_at, '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i') AS 'Date',
  x.tool_no AS 'Tool No',
  x.event_type AS 'Event Type',
  x.status AS 'Status',
  x.part_no AS 'Part No',
  x.part_name AS 'Part Name',
  x.machine AS 'Machine',
  x.issue AS 'Issue / Problem',
  x.priority AS 'Priority',
  x.root_cause AS 'Root Cause',
  x.action_taken AS 'Action Taken',
  x.remarks AS 'Remarks',
  x.spare_consumed AS 'Spare Consumed',
  x.current_stroke AS 'Current Stroke',
  x.next_stroke AS 'Next Stroke',
  (
  COALESCE((
    SELECT tl.TL_life_span
    FROM tool_life tl
    WHERE TRIM(tl.TL_tool_number) = TRIM(x.tool_no)
    ORDER BY tl.TL_created_at DESC, tl.TL_tool_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0)
  -
  x.current_stroke
) AS 'Life Balance',
  x.done_by AS 'Done By',
  DATE_FORMAT(x.completed_at, '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i') AS 'Completed At'
FROM (
  SELECT
    pm.PM_date AS event_at,
    pm.PM_tool_number COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS tool_no,
    'Preventive Maintenance' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS event_type,
    'Completed' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS status,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS part_no,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS part_name,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS machine,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS issue,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS priority,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS root_cause,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS action_taken,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS remarks,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS spare_consumed,
    pm.PM_current_stroke AS current_stroke,
    pm.PM_next_stroke AS next_stroke,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS done_by,
    pm.PM_date AS completed_at,
    COALESCE(pm.PM_maintenance_attachment, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS attachment
  FROM preventive_maintenance pm
  WHERE TRIM(pm.PM_tool_number) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = TRIM({toolName}) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    tb.downtime_at AS event_at,
    tb.tool_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS tool_no,
    'Tool Breakdown' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS event_type,
    CASE WHEN tb.completed_at IS NULL THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Completed' END COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS status,
    COALESCE(tb.part_no, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS part_no,
    COALESCE(tb.part_name, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS part_name,
    COALESCE(tb.machine_name, tb.machine_id, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS machine,
    COALESCE(tb.issue, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS issue,
    COALESCE(tb.priority, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS priority,
    COALESCE(tb.root_cause, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS root_cause,
    COALESCE(tb.action_taken, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS action_taken,
    COALESCE(tb.remarks, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS remarks,
    COALESCE(tb.spare_consumed, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS spare_consumed,
    current_stroke AS current_stroke,
    next_stroke AS next_stroke,
    COALESCE(tb.completed_by_name, tb.completed_by_login, tb.operator_name, tb.operator_login, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS done_by,
    tb.completed_at AS completed_at,
    '' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS attachment
  FROM tool_breakdowns tb
  WHERE TRIM(tb.tool_no) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = TRIM({toolName}) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
) x
ORDER BY x.event_at ASC;

    MAX(gm_name) AS Grade,
    MAX(coalesce(pl_name,'')) AS Plating,
    MAX(coalesce(ft_name,'') ) AS 'Finish Type',
    MAX(CO_MICRON) AS Micron,
    -- Aggregate material names and tool numbers
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.MM_RawMtPartNo ORDER BY t.MM_RawMtPartNo) AS 'RawMaterial/s',
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.CT_TOOLNO ORDER BY t.CT_TOOLNO) AS 'Tool/s'
FROM components c
LEFT JOIN customer ON CO_CUSTID = cu_id
LEFT JOIN materialtypemaster ON co_materialtypeid = mt_id
LEFT JOIN grademaster ON CO_GRADEID = gm_id
LEFT JOIN plating ON CO_ELECTROPLATING = pl_id
LEFT JOIN finishtype ON CO_FINISH = ft_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CT_COMPID,
        CT_TOOLNO,
        CT_RMID,
        MM_RawMtPartNo,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * 
         ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
    FROM components_tool
    INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
    INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
    WHERE CT_ActiveYN='Y' AND CT_PPC='Y'
      AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0
) t ON t.CT_COMPID = CO_ID
WHERE CO_ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CO_PARENTID 
    FROM components 
    WHERE CO_ACTIVEYN='Y'
)
GROUP BY CO_ID
order by cu_name,CO_PARTNO ;

SELECT
  CO_PARTNO partno,
  CO_PARTNAME partname,
  SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(irr.production_pending, 0), 0)) planned,
  SUM(COALESCE(cust.scheduled_qty, 0)) scheduled,
  SUM(COALESCE(pr.prodqty, 0)) produced,
  SUM(
    GREATEST(COALESCE(irr.production_pending, 0), 0)
    - GREATEST(COALESCE(irr.balance_production_qty, 0), 0)
  ) valid_actual,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(pr.prodqty, 0)
    - (
      GREATEST(COALESCE(irr.production_pending, 0), 0)
      - GREATEST(COALESCE(irr.balance_production_qty, 0), 0)
    )
  ) excess,
  SUM(COALESCE(disp.dispqty, 0)) dispatched,
  sm.SM_MONTH mn,
  sm.SM_YEAR yr
FROM schedule_master sm
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT sc_smid, CO_PARENTID AS parent_compid
  FROM schedule_details sd
  LEFT JOIN components c ON sd.sc_compid = c.co_id
) sd ON sd.sc_smid = sm_id
LEFT JOIN components ON co_id = parent_compid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT cp.CO_PARENTID comp, sc_smid smid, SUM(SD_LOTSIZE) dispqty
  FROM scheduled_customerdispatch
  LEFT JOIN scheduled_customer ON SD_CSID = CS_Id
  LEFT JOIN schedule_details ON SC_Id = CS_SCID
  LEFT JOIN components cp ON cp.co_id = SC_COMPID
  WHERE SD_Status = 7
  GROUP BY cp.CO_PARENTID, sc_smid
) disp ON disp.smid = sm.SM_ID AND parent_compid = disp.comp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp,
    sp.PS_SMID AS smid,
    SUM(pd.PD_PRODQTY) AS prodqty
  FROM scheduled_production sp
  JOIN production_details pd ON pd.PD_PSID = sp.PS_ID AND pd_ecsid = 8
  GROUP BY sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID, sp.PS_SMID
) pr ON pr.smid = sm.SM_ID AND parent_compid = pr.comp
LEFT JOIN inventory_report_rows irr
  ON irr.part_id = parent_compid
  AND irr.report_month = sm.SM_MONTH
  AND irr.report_year = sm.SM_YEAR
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sm2.SM_ID AS smid,
    c2.CO_PARENTID AS comp,
    SUM(sc.CS_QTY) AS scheduled_qty
  FROM schedule_master sm2
  JOIN schedule_details sd2 ON sm2.SM_ID = sd2.SC_SMID
  JOIN scheduled_customer sc ON sd2.SC_ID = sc.CS_SCID
  JOIN components c2 ON sd2.SC_COMPID = c2.CO_ID
  WHERE sc.CS_SCHEDULESTATE IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY sm2.SM_ID, c2.CO_PARENTID
) cust ON cust.smid = sm.SM_ID AND cust.comp = parent_compid
GROUP BY sm.SM_MONTH, sm.SM_YEAR, CO_PARTNO, CO_PARTNAME, parent_compid
) t
WHERE (CASE WHEN mn >= 4 THEN yr ELSE yr - 1 END) = {year}
GROUP BY partno, partname

reports.name: RM Stock Location-wise( Includes NPD)  OLD
reports.queryTemplate:
select  MM_RawMtPartNo 'RawMaterial',mt_name 'Material',
	Batch ,date_format(ri_date, '%d-%m-%Y')  'InwardDt', 
	RD_ACCEPTEDQTY 'inwardQty', storeQty as 'RM In Store',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(ProdQty,0),0),2) 'RMGivenForProd' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(ThRMForProduction,0),0),2) 'RMUsed(Theo)' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST((rmwithprod),0),0),2) as 'RM with Prod(Theo)' ,
    round(COALESCE(GREATEST(RMPendingAtProd,0),0),2) RMPendingClearanceAtProd,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(pdscrap,0),0),2) 'ProdScrap',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(SplitQty,0),0),2) 'RW with Slitting' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(SlitingScrap,0),0),2) 'SlitingScrap' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWRMGiven,0),0),2) 'JWRMGiven',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWretqty,0),0),2) 'JWRetQty', 
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWcompkg,0),0),2) 'JWCompKg',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWscarp,0),0),2) 'JWSrap',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(jwRemQty,0),0),2) 'RM with JW Vendor' from 
	(select inQ.rd_rmid rm, inQ.batch Batch,inQ.ri_date ri_date, 
	inQ.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY , rmStore.Qty storeQty,
	ProdQty,coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)ThRMForProduction ,ProdQty-coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)  rmwithprod ,  ProdQty-coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)-coalesce(PL_Kg,0) RMPendingAtProd,
	pdscrap -coalesce(PScrapCorrection,0) pdscrap,SplitQty,SlitingScrap-coalesce(SScrapCorrection,0) SlitingScrap,
    JWRMGiven,JWretqty, JWcompkg,JWscarp -coalesce(JWScrapCorrection,0) JWscarp ,jwRemQty,
	lp.PL_kg  loss
	FROM 
	(select rd_rmid , RD_BATCHNO batch ,ri_date, sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY  ) RD_ACCEPTEDQTY
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1
		 left join materialmaster on mm_id = rd_rmid
		 where RD_ACCEPTEDQTY>0
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,ri_date,rd_rmid
		   union
		select rmin.rd_rmid , rmin.RD_BATCHNO batch ,rmin.ri_date, rmin.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY   RD_ACCEPTEDQTY from 
		(SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and rd_outwardid <>0 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmin,
		 (SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENT='O' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmout
		 where rmin.rd_rmid <>rmout.rd_rmid and rmin.RD_BATCHNO = rmout.RD_BATCHNO     
		 )inQ
		 left join (SELECT RD_BATCHNO batch, RD_RMID	,	
			round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)
				- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END), 2 )AS Qty
		FROM rm_inwarddetails , rm_inwardmaster
		where rd_riid=ri_id 
		group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid) rmStore on rmStore.batch= inQ.batch and rmStore.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 left join (select RD_BATCHNO batch,rd_rmid,
	round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_acceptedqty ELSE 0 END) ,2)AS ProdQty
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 where RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid
		 ) prod on prod.batch = inQ.batch and prod.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 left join (select RD_BATCHNO batch, rd_rmid,coalesce(sum(rd_qty),0) - coalesce(sum(retqty),0) -coalesce(sum(SlitingScrap),0) SplitQty, coalesce(sum(SlitingScrap),0) SlitingScrap
		 from rm_inwarddetails rd
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 left join ( select RD_OUTWARDID, sum(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_acceptedqty ELSE 0 END) retqty
			from rm_inwarddetails, rm_inwardmaster where rd_riid= ri_id 
			and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 2 and  RI_MOVEMENT = 'I' group by RD_OUTWARDID
		 )SplitRet on SplitRet.RD_OUTWARDID = rd.rd_id
		 left join ( select RS_OUTWARDID,sum(rs_qty) SlitingScrap from rm_scrapdetails group by RS_OUTWARDID     
		 )scrap on scrap.RS_OUTWARDID = rd.rd_id 
		 where RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 2 and  RI_MOVEMENT = 'O'
         group by RD_BATCHNO , rd_rmid
		 ) Splitting on Splitting.batch = inQ.batch and Splitting.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
	left join (  select pd_batchno batch, mm_id,round(coalesce(sum((PD_PRODQTY)/conVal),0),2)  ThRMForProduction ,  coalesce(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),0) pdscrap from production_details
		left join scheduled_production on pd_psid = ps_id 
		left join comp_scrapdetails on sd_refno =pd_id and sd_src=1
		left join 
		(SELECT ct_id,CT_COMPID,mm_id ,((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) as conVal FROM components_tool
				inner join materialmaster on CT_RMID = MM_Id inner join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id where   CT_PPC='Y' and CT_PITCH > 0 
				and CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0)t on CT_COMPID= PS_PARENTCOMPID  and ct_id = PD_TOOLID
				group by  pd_batchno,mm_id)prodQ on prodQ.batch=inQ.batch and prodQ.mm_id = inQ.rd_rmid
		left join(select RD_BATCHNO batch,rd_rmid, rmgiven JWRMGiven ,sum(COALESCE(retRMqty,0)) JWretqty,sum(COALESCE(compkgqty,0))+ sum(COALESCE(sfRej,0)) JWcompkg,sum(COALESCE(scrapqty,0)) JWscarp, -- + sum(COALESCE(setupW,0))
			round((rmgiven-(sum(COALESCE(retRMqty,0))+ sum(COALESCE(compkgqty,0))  +sum(COALESCE(scrapqty,0)))),2) as jwRemQty from (   -- + sum(COALESCE(sfRej,0)) + sum(COALESCE(setupW,0))
			select rd_batchno, RD_RMID,RMGiven, retRMqty,compKGQty, scrapqty,sfRej,setupW,RI_MOVEMENTTYPE,ri.ri_id , rd.rd_riid
			from rm_inwardmaster ri,rm_inwarddetails rd
			join
			(select sum(rd_qty) RMGiven, RD_BATCHNO batch from rm_inwarddetails, rm_inwardmaster where rd_riid= ri_id and RI_MOVEMENT='O' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=4 group by RD_BATCHNO)r on r.batch = rd.rd_batchno
			left join  (select rd_id,RD_OUTWARDid, sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY) retRMqty from rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and ri_movementtype=4 group by RD_OUTWARDID, rd_batchno,rd_id)ret on ret.RD_OUTWARDID= rd.rd_id 
			left join (select sum(cd_kgqty) compKGQty , cd_outwardid, sum(cr_qtykg) sfRej, sum(SD_QTYKG) setupW from comp_inwarddetails
				left join comp_rejectdetails on cr_cmid= cd_cmid
				left join comp_scrapdetails on sd_refno =cd_cmid and sd_src=4
				 where cd_src=4   group by cd_outwardid)comp on cd_outwardid=  ret.rd_id
			left join (SELECT rs_qty scrapqty,RS_OUTWARDID FROM rm_scrapdetails) scrap on scrap.RS_OUTWARDID=  ret.rd_id 
			where ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=4
			) t
			group by rd_batchno,rd_rmid) jwQty on jwQty.batch = inQ.batch   and jwQty.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid    
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
			  TRIM(rc_batchno) AS rc_batchno,   rc_rmid,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='P' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS PScrapCorrection,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='S' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS SScrapCorrection,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='J' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS JWScrapCorrection
			FROM rm_scrapcorrection       
			GROUP BY rc_batchno, rc_rmid,rc_movementtype
		   ) scrapCorrections ON scrapCorrections.rc_batchno = inQ.batch  AND scrapCorrections.rc_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
			left join (select PL_RMID,pl_batch,coalesce(sum(PL_kg),0) PL_kg from  rm_prodloss group by PL_RMID,pl_batch) lp on lp.PL_RMID =  inQ.rd_rmid and lp.pl_batch = inQ.batch  
			)t1 left join materialmaster on mm_id = t1.rm
			left join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id
			where storeQty >0 or rmwithprod >0 or jwRemQty>0 or splitQty>0 
order by MM_RawMtPartNo;

reports.name: RM Issue-wise details
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT tab.*,
       ROUND((TheoRMRemaining - LossQty - SysLoss - ReturnQty),4) AS PendingRMClearance
FROM (
    SELECT 
        MAX(MM_RawMtPartNo) AS RawMaterial,
        MAX(rd_batchno) AS BatchNo,
        MAX(RI_REPORTNO) AS IssueNo,
        DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ri_date), '%d-%m-%Y') AS IssueDate,
        MAX(co_partno) AS PartNo,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(PD_PRODQTY),0),4) AS PartQty,
        COALESCE(RD_QTY,0) AS IssueQty,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(PD_PRODQTY/conVal),0),4) AS TheoRM_kg,
        ROUND(COALESCE(RD_QTY,0) - COALESCE(SUM(PD_PRODQTY/conVal),0),4) AS TheoRMRemaining,
        COALESCE(MAX(lp.PL_kg),0) AS LossQty,
        COALESCE(PLR_NAME,'') AS LossReason,
        COALESCE(MAX(ls.PL_kg),0) AS SysLoss,
        COALESCE(retQty,0) AS ReturnQty
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT(co_parentid) sc_compid, sc_smid, CO_PARTNO, CO_PARTNAME
        FROM schedule_details
        LEFT JOIN components ON sc_compid = co_id
    ) sd
    LEFT JOIN schedule_master ON sm_id = sc_smid
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM rm_inwarddetails
        JOIN rm_inwardmaster ON rd_riid = ri_id
        WHERE RI_MOVEMENT='O' AND RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
    ) r ON rd_smid = sm_id AND RD_COMPID = SC_COMPID
    LEFT JOIN production_details ON pd_rdid = rd_id
    LEFT JOIN materialmaster ON mm_id = rd_rmid
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT rd.RD_ID retrdid,
               rd.RD_BATCHNO AS retbatch,
               COALESCE(SUM(rdret.RD_QTY),0) AS retQty
        FROM rm_inwarddetails rd
        JOIN rm_inwardmaster ri ON rd.RD_RIID = ri.RI_ID
                               AND ri.RI_MOVEMENT = 'O'
                               AND ri.RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
        LEFT JOIN rm_inwarddetails rdret ON rdret.RD_OUTWARDID = rd.RD_ID
        LEFT JOIN rm_inwardmaster riret ON rdret.RD_RIID = riret.RI_ID
                                       AND riret.RI_MOVEMENT = 'I'
                                       AND riret.RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
        GROUP BY rd.RD_ID, rd.RD_BATCHNO
        HAVING retQty > 0
    ) rettable ON rd_id = retrdid
    LEFT JOIN rm_prodloss lp ON lp.pl_rdid = rd_id
                            AND lp.pl_batch = RD_BATCHNO
                            AND lp.PL_CATEGORY = 'P'
    LEFT JOIN rm_prodloss ls ON ls.pl_rdid = rd_id
                            AND ls.pl_batch = RD_BATCHNO
                            AND ls.PL_CATEGORY = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN rm_prodlossreason ON PLR_ID = lp.PL_LOSSREASON
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT CT_ID AS ctid, CT_COMPID,
               ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * 
                ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
        FROM components_tool
        INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
        INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
        WHERE CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0
    ) toolConv ON ctid = pd_toolid AND CT_COMPID = sc_compid
    WHERE rd_qty > 0
      AND sm_month ={month}
      AND sm_year = {year}
    GROUP BY sm_month, sm_year, sc_compid, rd_id, RD_QTY, PLR_NAME

reports.queryTemplate:
select  MM_RawMtPartNo 'RawMaterial',mt_name 'Material',
	Batch ,
	RD_ACCEPTEDQTY 'inwardQty', storeQty as 'RM In Store',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(ProdQty,0),0),2) 'RMGivenForProd' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(ThRMForProduction,0),0),2) 'RMUsed(Theo)' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST((rmwithprod),0),0),2) as 'RM with Prod(Theo)' ,
    round(COALESCE(GREATEST(RMPendingAtProd,0),0),2) RMPendingClearanceAtProd,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(pdscrap,0),0),2) 'ProdScrap',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(SplitQty,0),0),2) 'RW with Slitting' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(SlitingScrap,0),0),2) 'SlitingScrap' ,
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWRMGiven,0),0),2) 'JWRMGiven',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWretqty,0),0),2) 'JWRetQty', 
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWcompkg,0),0),2) 'JWCompKg',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(JWscarp,0),0),2) 'JWSrap',
	round(COALESCE(GREATEST(jwRemQty,0),0),2) 'RM with JW Vendor' from 
	(select inQ.rd_rmid rm, inQ.batch Batch, 
	inQ.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY , rmStore.Qty storeQty,
	ProdQty,coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)ThRMForProduction ,ProdQty-coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)  rmwithprod ,  ProdQty-coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)-coalesce(PL_Kg,0) RMPendingAtProd,
	pdscrap -coalesce(PScrapCorrection,0) pdscrap,SplitQty,SlitingScrap-coalesce(SScrapCorrection,0) SlitingScrap,
    JWRMGiven,JWretqty, JWcompkg,JWscarp -coalesce(JWScrapCorrection,0) JWscarp ,jwRemQty,
	lp.PL_kg  loss
	FROM 
	(select rd_rmid ,  batch , sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY  ) RD_ACCEPTEDQTY from ( select rd_rmid , RD_BATCHNO batch ,ri_date, sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY  ) RD_ACCEPTEDQTY
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1
		 left join materialmaster on mm_id = rd_rmid
		 where RD_ACCEPTEDQTY>0
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,ri_date,rd_rmid
		   union
		select rmin.rd_rmid , rmin.RD_BATCHNO batch ,rmin.ri_date, rmin.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY   RD_ACCEPTEDQTY from 
		(SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and rd_outwardid <>0 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmin,
		 (SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENT='O' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmout
		 where rmin.rd_rmid <>rmout.rd_rmid and rmin.RD_BATCHNO = rmout.RD_BATCHNO  )tt  group by    rd_rmid ,  batch
		 )inQ
		 left join (SELECT RD_BATCHNO batch, RD_RMID	,	
			round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END)
				- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END), 2 )AS Qty
		FROM rm_inwarddetails , rm_inwardmaster
		where rd_riid=ri_id 
		group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid) rmStore on rmStore.batch= inQ.batch and rmStore.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 left join (select RD_BATCHNO batch,rd_rmid,
	round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_acceptedqty ELSE 0 END) ,2)AS ProdQty
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 where RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid
		 ) prod on prod.batch = inQ.batch and prod.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 left join (select RD_BATCHNO batch, rd_rmid,coalesce(sum(rd_qty),0) - coalesce(sum(retqty),0) -coalesce(sum(SlitingScrap),0) SplitQty, coalesce(sum(SlitingScrap),0) SlitingScrap
		 from rm_inwarddetails rd
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 left join ( select RD_OUTWARDID, sum(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_acceptedqty ELSE 0 END) retqty
			from rm_inwarddetails, rm_inwardmaster where rd_riid= ri_id 
			and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 2 and  RI_MOVEMENT = 'I' group by RD_OUTWARDID
		 )SplitRet on SplitRet.RD_OUTWARDID = rd.rd_id
		 left join ( select RS_OUTWARDID,sum(rs_qty) SlitingScrap from rm_scrapdetails group by RS_OUTWARDID     
		 )scrap on scrap.RS_OUTWARDID = rd.rd_id 
		 where RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 2 and  RI_MOVEMENT = 'O'
         group by RD_BATCHNO , rd_rmid
		 ) Splitting on Splitting.batch = inQ.batch and Splitting.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
	left join (  select pd_batchno batch, mm_id,round(coalesce(sum((PD_PRODQTY)/conVal),0),2)  ThRMForProduction ,  coalesce(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),0) pdscrap from production_details
		left join scheduled_production on pd_psid = ps_id 
		left join comp_scrapdetails on sd_refno =pd_id and sd_src=1
		left join 
		(SELECT ct_id,CT_COMPID,mm_id ,((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) as conVal FROM components_tool
				inner join materialmaster on CT_RMID = MM_Id inner join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id where   CT_PPC='Y' and CT_PITCH > 0 
				and CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0)t on CT_COMPID= PS_PARENTCOMPID  and ct_id = PD_TOOLID
				group by  pd_batchno,mm_id)prodQ on prodQ.batch=inQ.batch and prodQ.mm_id = inQ.rd_rmid
		left join(select RD_BATCHNO batch,rd_rmid, rmgiven JWRMGiven ,sum(COALESCE(retRMqty,0)) JWretqty,sum(COALESCE(compkgqty,0))+ sum(COALESCE(sfRej,0)) JWcompkg,sum(COALESCE(scrapqty,0)) JWscarp, -- + sum(COALESCE(setupW,0))
			round((rmgiven-(sum(COALESCE(retRMqty,0))+ sum(COALESCE(compkgqty,0))  +sum(COALESCE(scrapqty,0)))),2) as jwRemQty from (   -- + sum(COALESCE(sfRej,0)) + sum(COALESCE(setupW,0))
			select rd_batchno, RD_RMID,RMGiven, retRMqty,compKGQty, scrapqty,sfRej,setupW,RI_MOVEMENTTYPE,ri.ri_id , rd.rd_riid
			from rm_inwardmaster ri,rm_inwarddetails rd
			join
			(select sum(rd_qty) RMGiven, RD_BATCHNO batch from rm_inwarddetails, rm_inwardmaster where rd_riid= ri_id and RI_MOVEMENT='O' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=4 group by RD_BATCHNO)r on r.batch = rd.rd_batchno
			left join  (select rd_id,RD_OUTWARDid, sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY) retRMqty from rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and ri_movementtype=4 group by RD_OUTWARDID, rd_batchno,rd_id)ret on ret.RD_OUTWARDID= rd.rd_id 
			left join (select sum(cd_kgqty) compKGQty , cd_outwardid, sum(cr_qtykg) sfRej, sum(SD_QTYKG) setupW from comp_inwarddetails
				left join comp_rejectdetails on cr_cmid= cd_cmid
				left join comp_scrapdetails on sd_refno =cd_cmid and sd_src=4
				 where cd_src=4   group by cd_outwardid)comp on cd_outwardid=  ret.rd_id
			left join (SELECT rs_qty scrapqty,RS_OUTWARDID FROM rm_scrapdetails) scrap on scrap.RS_OUTWARDID=  ret.rd_id 
			where ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=4
			) t
			group by rd_batchno,rd_rmid) jwQty on jwQty.batch = inQ.batch   and jwQty.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid    
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
			  TRIM(rc_batchno) AS rc_batchno,   rc_rmid,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='P' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS PScrapCorrection,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='S' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS SScrapCorrection,
			  case when  rc_movementtype='J' then ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(rc_correction, 0)), 2) else 0 end AS JWScrapCorrection
			FROM rm_scrapcorrection       
			GROUP BY rc_batchno, rc_rmid,rc_movementtype
		   ) scrapCorrections ON scrapCorrections.rc_batchno = inQ.batch  AND scrapCorrections.rc_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
			left join (select PL_RMID,pl_batch,coalesce(sum(PL_kg),0) PL_kg from  rm_prodloss group by PL_RMID,pl_batch) lp on lp.PL_RMID =  inQ.rd_rmid and lp.pl_batch = inQ.batch  
			)t1 left join materialmaster on mm_id = t1.rm
			left join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id
			where storeQty >0 or rmwithprod >0 or jwRemQty>0 or splitQty>0 
-- order by MM_RawMtPartNo;
order by  inQ.batch;

reports.name: Material Scrap Child
reports.queryTemplate:
select mt_name MaterialName, MM_RawMtPartNo RawMaterial, round(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),2) 'Scrap(Kg)', round( (sum(pd_prodqty/conVal) -sum(pd_prodqty*co_weight/1000)),2) as 'Theo Scrap', COALESCE(MAX(ls.PL_kg),0) AS SysLoss, COALESCE(MAX(lp.PL_kg),0) AS ProdLoss
from production_details 
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join components_tool on PD_TOOLID = ct_id
left  join materialtypemaster on mm_mtid = mt_id
LEFT JOIN rm_prodloss lp ON lp.pl_rdid = pd_rdid
                            AND lp.pl_batch = PD_BATCHNO
                            AND lp.PL_CATEGORY = 'P'
LEFT JOIN rm_prodloss ls ON ls.pl_rdid = pd_rdid
                            AND ls.pl_batch = PD_BATCHNO
                            AND ls.PL_CATEGORY = 'S'
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id  
 where Date(pd_date) between {fromDate} and {toDate} 
and pd_ecsid = 8
and mt_name ={material}
group by MM_RawMtPartNo
order by  MM_RawMtPartNo;

reports.name: RM below Minimum Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
select mm_rawmtpartno RawMaterial,mm_minstock MinimumStock,round(coalesce(sum(storeQty),0),4) 'Qty At Store',
round(coalesce(sum(RMPendingAtProd),0),4) 'PendingClearance At Prod'
from (
select inQ.rd_rmid rm, inQ.batch Batch, 
	inQ.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY , rmStore.Qty storeQty,
	coalesce(ProdQty,0),coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0)ThRMForProduction ,
    CASE 
    WHEN (coalesce(ProdQty,0)- coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0) - coalesce(PL_Kg,0)) < 0 
    THEN 0 
    ELSE (coalesce(ProdQty,0)- coalesce(ThRMForProduction,0) - coalesce(PL_Kg,0)) 
END AS RMPendingAtProd
	FROM 
	(select rd_rmid ,  batch , sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY  ) RD_ACCEPTEDQTY from ( select rd_rmid , RD_BATCHNO batch ,ri_date, sum(RD_ACCEPTEDQTY  ) RD_ACCEPTEDQTY
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1
		 left join materialmaster on mm_id = rd_rmid
		 where RD_ACCEPTEDQTY>0
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,ri_date,rd_rmid
		   union
		select rmin.rd_rmid , rmin.RD_BATCHNO batch ,rmin.ri_date, rmin.RD_ACCEPTEDQTY   RD_ACCEPTEDQTY from 
		(SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and rd_outwardid <>0 and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmin,
		 (SELECT * FROM rm_inwarddetails,rm_inwardmaster where  ri_id = rd_riid and RI_MOVEMENT='O' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=2) rmout
		 where rmin.rd_rmid <>rmout.rd_rmid and rmin.RD_BATCHNO = rmout.RD_BATCHNO  )tt  group by    rd_rmid ,  batch
		 )inQ
		 left join (SELECT RD_BATCHNO batch, RD_RMID	,	
			round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END)
				- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_Acceptedqty ELSE 0 END), 2 )AS Qty
		FROM rm_inwarddetails , rm_inwardmaster
		where rd_riid=ri_id 
		group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid) rmStore on rmStore.batch= inQ.batch and rmStore.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 left join (select RD_BATCHNO batch,rd_rmid,
	round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_acceptedqty ELSE 0 END) ,2)AS ProdQty
	from rm_inwarddetails
		 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
		 where RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = 3
		 group by RD_BATCHNO,rd_rmid
		 ) prod on prod.batch = inQ.batch and prod.rd_rmid = inQ.rd_rmid
		 
	left join (  select pd_batchno batch, mm_id,round(coalesce(sum((PD_PRODQTY)/conVal),0),2)  ThRMForProduction ,  coalesce(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),0) pdscrap from production_details
		left join scheduled_production on pd_psid = ps_id 
		left join comp_scrapdetails on sd_refno =pd_id and sd_src=1
		left join 
		(SELECT ct_id,CT_COMPID,mm_id ,((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) as conVal FROM components_tool
				inner join materialmaster on CT_RMID = MM_Id inner join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id where   CT_PPC='Y' and CT_PITCH > 0 
				and CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0)t on CT_COMPID= PS_PARENTCOMPID  and ct_id = PD_TOOLID
				group by  pd_batchno,mm_id)prodQ on prodQ.batch=inQ.batch and prodQ.mm_id = inQ.rd_rmid
		
			left join 
            (select PL_RMID,pl_batch,coalesce(sum(PL_kg),0) PL_kg from  rm_prodloss group by PL_RMID,pl_batch) lp on lp.PL_RMID =  inQ.rd_rmid and lp.pl_batch = inQ.batch  
)res
left join materialmaster on  mm_id = rm
where (RMPendingAtProd + storeQty)< mm_minstock
group by rm
order by mm_minstock desc

reports.name: Monthly Schedule - Dispatch
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  sch.Customer,
  sch.PartNo,
  sch.scheduleCount,
  sch.TotalScheduleQty,
  COALESCE(disp.DispatchCount, 0) AS DispatchCount,
  COALESCE(disp.TotaldispatchQty, 0) AS TotaldispatchQty
FROM (
  SELECT
    CU_Name AS Customer,
    CO_PARTNO AS PartNo,
    CS_SCID,
    CS_CUSTID,
    SC_COMPID,
    COUNT(*) AS scheduleCount,
    SUM(CS_QTY) AS TotalScheduleQty
  FROM scheduled_customer
  LEFT JOIN schedule_details ON CS_SCID = SC_ID
  LEFT JOIN schedule_master ON SC_SMID = SM_ID
  LEFT JOIN components ON CO_ID = SC_COMPID
  LEFT JOIN customer ON CS_CUSTID = CU_ID
  WHERE SM_MONTH = {month}
    AND SM_YEAR = {year} and CS_SCHEDULESTATE IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY CS_SCID, CS_CUSTID, CU_Name, CO_PARTNO, SC_COMPID
) sch
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    CS_SCID,
    CS_CUSTID,
    COUNT(*) AS DispatchCount,
    COALESCE(SUM(SD_LOTSIZE), 0) AS TotaldispatchQty
  FROM scheduled_customer
  LEFT JOIN schedule_details ON CS_SCID = SC_ID
  LEFT JOIN schedule_master ON SC_SMID = SM_ID
  LEFT JOIN components ON CO_ID = SC_COMPID
  LEFT JOIN customer ON CS_CUSTID = CU_ID
  LEFT JOIN scheduled_customerdispatch
    ON SD_CSID = CS_ID AND SD_STATUS = 7
  WHERE SM_MONTH = {month}
    AND SM_YEAR = {year}
    AND CS_SCHEDULESTATE IN (1, 2, 3)
    AND SD_DISPATCHDATE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CS_SCID, CS_CUSTID
) disp ON disp.CS_SCID = sch.CS_SCID AND disp.CS_CUSTID = sch.CS_CUSTID
ORDER BY sch.Customer, sch.SC_COMPID;

from scheduled_customer
	left join schedule_details on cs_scid=sc_id
	left join schedule_master on sc_smid= sm_id
    left  join components on co_id = sc_compid
    left join customer on CS_CUSTID = cu_id
 where sm_month = {month} and SM_YEAR= {year}  and trim(co_partno) ={co_partno}
and trim(CU_Name) ={customer}

from scheduled_customer

    left  join components on co_id = sc_compid
    left join customer on CS_CUSTID = cu_id

 order by CU_Name,sc_compid;

reports.name: Consolidated-Component Month-wise Production(Ref to Schedule)
reports.queryTemplate:
select  CO_PARTNO 'Part No', MM_RawMtPartNo 'Raw Material',
 sum(pd_prodqty)  'No Of Comp', sum(PD_SFREJECT) 'SF Rej(Nos)',sum(PD_SWQTY) 'SU Wastage(Nos)',round(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),2) 'Scrap(Kg)',
 round(sum(PD_QTYKG),2) 'Part Wt(Kg)', round(sum(pd_prodqty/conVal),2) 'Theo RM(Kg)', round(sum(pd_prodqty*co_weight/1000),2) 'Theo Part Wt', 
 round( (sum(pd_prodqty/conVal) -sum(pd_prodqty*co_weight/1000)),2) as 'Theo Scrap'
from production_details 
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join components_tool on PD_TOOLID = ct_id
left join schedule_master on sm_id = ps_smid
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id 
where sm_month = {month} and SM_YEAR= {year} and pd_ecsid = 8
group by CO_PARTNO,MM_RawMtPartNo
order by  CO_PARTNO;

reports.name: Inwarded Raw Material after Inspection
reports.queryTemplate:
select RI_REPORTNO as ReportNo,DATE_FORMAT(RI_DATE, '%M-%Y') as 'Month - Inward', DATE_FORMAT(RI_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') as Date,
ss_Name as Supplier,RI_PO as PO, ri_invoice AS'Invoice No',MM_RawMtPartNo as RawMaterial, MT_Name as MaterialType, 
RD_BATCHNO as BatchNo,RD_QTY as 'Inward Qty',RD_RECEIVEDQTY as 'Received Qty',  RD_ACCEPTEDQTY as 'Accepted Qty',date_format(RI_LASTUPDATED,'%d-%m-%Y') as 'Inspection Date'
 from rm_inwarddetails left join rm_inwardmaster on RI_ID = RD_RIID
 left join materialmaster on RD_RMID = MM_Id
 left join supplier on RI_SUPPLIERID = ss_Id
 left join materialtypemaster on MM_mtId=mt_id
 where month(RI_DATE) = {month} and year(RI_DATE) ={year} and RI_REPORTNO like 'INV%' and RI_INSPECTIONYN = 'Y'  and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1;

reports.name: temp
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  CO_partNo AS 'Part No',
  sum(CS_QTY) AS 'Requested Qty(Nos)',
COALESCE(sum(SD_LOTSIZE),0) 
FROM scheduled_customer
 LEFT join (select sd_csid, sum(coalesce(sd_lotsize,0)) sd_lotsize  from scheduled_customerdispatch where SD_STATUS=7 group by sd_csid) disp
		on disp.sd_csid = cs_id 
INNER JOIN customer ON CU_Id = CS_CUSTID
INNER JOIN schedule_details ON SC_Id = CS_SCID
INNER JOIN components ON CO_Id = SC_COMPID
WHERE CS_SCHEDULESTATE in ( 1,2,3) 
 AND CS_DATE between {from_date}
AND {to_date}
group by CO_partNo;
